title: Tip – Access the Clipboard with Business Central
summary: This post explains how to use the WebPageViewer control add-in to implement a copy-to-clipboard feature for URLs and text in Business Central pages, including handling browser security restrictions on HTTP connections.
key_points: WebPageViewer control add-in can display HTML and JavaScript for lightweight UI enhancements without building custom add-ins
Use JavaScript's navigator.clipboard.writeText() to copy text to clipboard and add event listeners for user feedback
HTTP connections block clipboard access by default; enable 'Insecure origins treated as secure' browser flag for local testing
HTTPS connections work without additional configuration for clipboard operations

quotes.text: That is because by default the clipboard is not available to sites which are served over http.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the root cause of clipboard failures in local testing environments and why configuration is needed
